answer.text:
**Texas Tech K-12 Dual Credit Overview**

Texas Tech K-12 offers dual credit opportunities that allow eligible high school students to earn both high school and college credit simultaneously by taking Texas Tech University courses online.

---

**Dual Credit Program Options**

- **8-Week Online Dual Credit**
  - Instructor-led Texas Tech University courses in an accelerated 8-week format.
  - Structured schedule with weekly assignments and deadlines.
  - Best for students who want a college classroom experience online.
  - Tuition: Approximately $415–$500 per credit hour, depending on student type.
  - Apply here: [Apply for 8-Week Online Dual Credit](https://texastech.my.site.com/online/TX_SiteLogin?startURL=%2Fonline%2FTargetX_Portal__PB)

- **Self-Paced Dual Credit**
  - Complete coursework online at your own pace.
  - Greater flexibility and independence.
  - Tuition and fees vary.
  - Apply here: [Apply for Self-Paced Dual Credit](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/dual-credit/course-info/)

- **College Preparatory Academy**
  - Structured, six-year pathway combining high school and college coursework.
  - Full-time Texas Tech K-12 enrollment required.
  - Designed to help students graduate high school with significant college credit and continue toward a Texas Tech bachelor’s degree.
  - Apply here: [Apply to the College Preparatory Academy](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/dual-credit/prep-academy/)

---

**Eligibility Requirements**

- Earn a Masters Grade Level score on required STAAR assessments.
- Maintain a 3.0 GPA.
- Provide one academic recommendation letter.
- College Preparatory Academy requires full-time Texas Tech K-12 enrollment and additional requirements (Meets/Masters STAAR, 3.0 GPA, recommendation letter, academic score benchmarks).

---

**Key Details**

- You do not have to be a full-time Texas Tech K-12 student to take dual credit courses; students from public, private, charter, or other high schools may participate.
- Students may participate in either 8-week online dual credit or self-paced dual credit, but not both concurrently.
- Dual credit grades become part of your permanent college record.
- Students should work with their counselor to ensure dual credit courses align with high school graduation requirements.

---

**Technology Requirements**

- Reliable internet and a computer that meets university technical requirements.
- See [technology requirements](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/support/handbook.php/#technology) for details.

---

**Support and More Information**

- For more information about the College Prep Academy, contact Brittany Perez at brittany.perez@ttu.edu.
- General support: 1-800-692-6877 or ttuk12@ttu.edu

---

**Helpful Links**

- [Dual Credit FAQ](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/dual-credit/faq/)
- [Dual Credit Course Info](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/dual-credit/course-info/)
- [College Preparatory Academy](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/dual-credit/prep-academy/)

answer.text:
**Texas Tech K-12 Tuition-Free Program Overview**

The Texas Tech K-12 Tuition-Free Program is an online academic program available to eligible full-time Texas residents. Here’s what you need to know:

---

**Eligibility Requirements**

- Must be a Texas resident under the age of 25.
- Must withdraw from your local school district to attend full-time.
- The program must fit your academic needs.
- Must provide:
  - Proof of Texas residency (e.g., current deed, lease, mortgage statement, utility bill, military documents, or a letter from the Texas Juvenile Justice Department).
  - Birth certificate.
  - Unofficial transcript.
- Must have access to a computer that meets minimum technology requirements and reliable internet.
- Must have a designated Learning Coach (parent/guardian or responsible adult).
- Must participate in all required State of Texas Assessments of Academic Readiness (STAAR) and End of Course (EOC) exams.

---

**Enrollment Process & Lottery System**

- Enrollment is limited; a lottery system is used to select students each semester.
- Fall Lottery: April 30, 2026
- Spring/Mid-Year Lottery: October 29, 2026
- If not selected, students are placed on a waitlist and notified if a spot opens.

---

**Program Features**

- **Free Enrollment:** No tuition or registration fees.
- **Free Online Textbooks:** All required textbooks are provided at no cost.
- **Flexible Online Learning:** Asynchronous courses allow students to work at their own pace within set deadlines.
- **State-Approved Curriculum:** Fully accredited and meets Texas Education Agency standards.
- **Support:** Access to Texas-certified teachers and academic advisors.

---

**Parent/Guardian Responsibilities**

- Provide a computer and reliable internet.
- Supply general school and household supplies (e.g., notebooks, pens, calculator).
- Serve as a Learning Coach to support the student’s progress.

---

**Attendance & Progress Requirements**

- Must be enrolled in at least four courses at all times.
- Attendance is tracked by progress: complete at least 5% of assignments in each course every week (minimum of 3 days per week).
- Courses must be completed within the designated semester timeline (no extensions).
- Failure to meet progress requirements may result in removal from the program.

---

**State Testing**

- Participation in STAAR/EOC exams is mandatory.
- Students who do not participate in state testing will be moved to the tuition-paid program.

---

**Key Dates for 2026-2027**

- First Semester: Courses open August 3, 2026; must be completed by January 15, 2027.
- Second Semester: Courses for new students open January 4, 2027; must be completed by June 30, 2027.

---

**Additional Notes**

- Siblings of selected students may get priority in the lottery if space allows.
- Students can take vacation days if they are on track with progress.
- The shortest time to complete a course is 30 days.
- Extensions are not allowed.

---

**How to Apply**

1. Complete the [intake form](https://ttu.focusschoolsoftware.com/focus/apply/?_gl=1*v05loa*_gcl_au*NTY5NzA2ODU2LjE3MzA4NDA5OTY.*_ga*MjU0NDE2Nzg2LjE3MjMwNDQ2MTA.*_ga_TSPQSJQPQF*MTczMzI2MjA5Ni4xNzkuMS4xNzMzMjYyMTA1LjAuMC4w).
2. Submit required documents (birth certificate, proof of residency, transcript).
3. Wait for lottery selection and notification.

---

**Contact for Questions**

- Phone: 1-800-692-6877
- Email: ttuk12@ttu.edu

For full details, visit the [Tuition-Free Program page](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/freetuition/) and [requirements](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/freetuition/requirements/).
